description: This planning application proposes refurbishment works at No. 4 Fassett Road, London E8 1PA, including window replacements, removal of the PVC conservatory at the second storey of the outrigger and its replacement with a new brick-built bathroom, along with alterations to the rear elevation following removal of the external staircase.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>

REASON:&nbsp;To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

<p>The following shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture.</p><p>a) Proposed Brick</p><p>REASON:&nbsp;To ensure that the proposal does not detract from the character and appearance of the conservation area.</p>
